about: Subsystem labels of the E143 (OM-1 v1.9) main block modules, keyed by the module names of node emu/bin/fwmap.mjs static (a source basename, "Class (class)" or gap@<first entry>). A change to the static pass (discovery, attribution, fwmap/E143.seeds.json) can rename, split or merge modules; their labels must then be re-keyed (fwmap report lists the modules without a label and the labels without a module). One primary block per module; parts split a module by address range [start..end) (end 0xffffffff: the end of the module), and a function belongs to the part that holds its entry. block: the subsystem key. gap_relevant: code a native path would still have to reach in normal use (an upper bound: the labellers' rules differed slightly). evidence: D read from code or data, X executed in emu, I inference, ? unknown. label: what the code is. outside_normal_use: the blocks that are not code a camera runs in normal use (data decoded as code, factory adjustment and test, debug shells and logs, firmware update), which fwmap report's normal-use row leaves out. Labelled by agents from the fwmap data of October 2026.
